Subject: Exec workshop — room adjacency plan & redundant conferencing bridge

Hi team,

We’re locking the space for the Redwood executive workshop (Dec 3–4). I’ve attached the current floor-plan-v2.pdf with our intended footprint: main plenary (Room A), two adjoining breakout rooms (Rooms B & C), and a greenroom for speaker prep. Key asks from our side:

- Confirm that Rooms A/B can be treated as adjacent with a single contiguous AV zone (video wall + center stage + audience mics).
- Provide A/V inventory for Rooms A/B/C and confirm vendor handling for: primary SIP/Zoom Rooms bridge + PSTN fallback + duplicate encoder for redundancy.
- Network: we need a single dedicated 1Gbps uplink reserved for conference traffic during event hours (Dec 3, 08:00–20:00 & Dec 4, 07:00–17:00).
- Access/badging: we’ll provide a VIP list — need badging instructions and VIP escort plan.

Attachments: floor-plan-v2.pdf (sketch), and a very small sample badge template.

Please reply with confirmations and any constraints by EOD Thursday so we can finalize SOW and travel.

Thanks,
Irene

We can confirm the following at a high level:
- Rooms: The event center can open Rooms 3A (Plenary) and 3B (Breakout) to create an adjoining space with removable partition. Sightlines support a center stage and a 180° projection wall.
- A/V: We work frequently with Delta AV; they can provide primary codec/MCU for Zoom/SIP and a hot standby encoder for failover.
- Network: We can provision a dedicated 1Gbps circuit to your NOC, subject to 5 business day lead time for provisioning and on-site testing.
- Badging: We’ll supply a staffed check-in desk and VIP escort if you provide a finalized list 72 hours prior. Badging instructions attached.

Thanks — a couple of technical notes from infra:

- Network: 1Gbps dedicated is fine but we need a dedicated VLAN with ACLs: conference mgmt, media RTP, and a small control plane for management only. Please confirm the switch model and whether the venue provides a /30 or routed IP for our edge.
- SIP/Bridge: require explicit SIP trunk failover and PSTN dial plan (we’ll provide carrier numbers). We also want dual encoders (primary + warm spare) with heartbeat monitoring; Delta, can you confirm if heartbeat supports automatic stream cutover?
- Power/rack: we need 2U rack space adjacent to A/V distro for our Edge NUC for on-site orchestration. List any UPS constraints in the venue ops sheet.

Linking to the support ticket we’ll open for work orders: Jira SUP-3421.

Marcus

From: Delta AV Solutions <support@deltaav.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, ops@summitvenues.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — bridge configuration & redundancy options

Hi Irene / team — Delta AV here. Quick summary of our proposed setup:

1) Primary: Hardware-based MCU using H.264/H.265 SVC to Zoom Rooms + direct SIP endpoints.
2) Redundancy: Secondary hardware encoder on a separate UPS, configured for automatic failover via STUN/TURN health checks (heartbeat every 10s). Cutover time ~3–5s for RTMP streams, under 10s for full SIP reconnection.
3) PSTN Failover: SIP trunk with carrier A as primary, carrier B as automatic fallback. We’ll provide dial-in numbers and local PSTN access for EU/US attendees.
4) Rehearsal windows: Dec 1 (14:00–16:00) and Dec 2 (09:00–11:00). Recommend full run-through with keynote slides, live Q&A, and one sponsor demo lane.
5) Gear list (summary): 2x hardware codecs, 2x redundant encoders, 4x tabletop boundary mics, 6x wireless lavs, 2x beamforming audience mics, 1x center 120" projection + 2x side monitors, 1x program mixer + backup console. Full line-items attached.

Attachments: bridge-config-deltaav.txt, line-item-quote.pdf

We confirm heartbeat-based failover; we’ll send a full runbook for on-site handoff by next Tuesday.

— Diego Fernandez
